### ✨ Game of Thrones (v1.4.22)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Player Speed Boost** — Enables custom movement speed multiplier
- **Move Speed Multiplier** — Scales CharacterMovement MaxWalkSpeed & MoveSpeed
- **Infinite Sprint / Stamina** — Prevents stamina depletion during dash & sprint
- **Attack Speed Boost** — Speeds up normal attacks, heavy attacks & combos
- **Attack Speed Multiplier** — Scales EStat::AttackSpeedMultiplier
- **Fast / Instant Skill Cast** — Reduces skill cooldowns & cast animation delays
- **Global Game Speed (Time Dilation)** — Scales entire game world execution speed
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Nullifies incoming fatal damage
- **Infinite Guard & Barrier** — Prevents guard break, groggy state & barrier loss
- **Outgoing Damage Multiplier** — Multiplies outgoing damage dealt by player
- **One Hit Kill** — Instantly eliminates struck enemies
- **Always Critical Strike** — Forces 100% Critical Hit chance on all attacks
- **Freeze Enemies (Zero Movement)** — Forces all enemy/NPC movement speeds to 0
- **Slow Motion Enemies (0.2x Speed)** — Reduces enemy mobility and reaction speed
- **Harmless / Dumb Enemies** — Disables enemy AI attacks & forces 0 enemy damage
- **Zero Enemy Defense** — Removes enemy defense rating, shields & barriers
- **Kill Nearby Enemies** — Eliminates active monsters in immediate vicinity
- **Auto Collect Nearby (In Range)** — Automatically opens chests & gathers nodes within 3.2m
- **Auto Teleport & Collect Far Away** — Warps you to nearest chest/resource & collects it
- **Instant Open / Zero Cast Gauge** — Skips interaction progress bar (0s open/gather)
- **Treasure & Gathering Radar** — Reveals chests, ? marks & resources across map
- **Infinite Eagle Vision / Scan** — 0s Search cooldown & 50,000m scan radius
- **Teleport & Collect Nearest Now** — Warps to closest active chest/herb & collects it
- **Bypass Damage Hack Check** — Suppresses USE_CHECK_DAMAGE_HACK detection
- **Bypass NPC Move Hack Check** — Suppresses USE_CHECK_NPC_MOVE_HACK detection
- **Bypass Skill Speed Hack Check** — Suppresses SKILL_SPEED_HACK_CHECKER detection
- **Prevent Hack Disconnects** — Disables GAME_HACK_DISCONNECT_ENABLED

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
